title: Multimodal upper-limb MI/ME EEG (Jeong et al. 2020)
description: A multimodal EEG dataset comprising 25 healthy subjects performing 11 intuitive upper-limb motor imagery and execution tasks across 3 sessions. The dataset includes 71 total channels (60-channel EEG, 4 EOG, 7 EMG) acquired at 1000 Hz, capturing reaching, grasping, and wrist-twisting movements. This resource is designed for brain-computer interface research and motor control applications.
methods_description: EEG data were acquired from 25 healthy right-handed subjects using a 60-channel actiCap with BrainAmp amplifier (BrainProducts GmbH) at 1000 Hz sampling rate. Reference electrode at FCz, ground at Fpz. Online filters: highpass 0.016 Hz, lowpass 1000 Hz. Additional EOG (4 channels) and EMG (7 channels) signals were recorded. Subjects performed 11 motor imagery tasks (6 reaching, 3 grasping, 2 wrist twisting) across 3 sessions with visual text cues, 4-second trial duration, and no feedback. This dataset is a BIDS-formatted derivative generated by MOABB (Mother of All BCI Benchmarks v1.5.0) from the original Jeong et al. 2020 dataset.
